name: io.github.lineagersiui-boop/sitemap-url-health-checker
title: Sitemap URL Health Checker (via Apify MCP)
description: Check sitemap URLs for 404s, redirects and noindex. One Apify Actor via Apify's hosted MCP server.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Your own Apify API token, sent as 'Bearer <apify-api-token>'. Runs are billed to your Apify account ($0.0005 per URL checked plus Apify platform usage).
